snippet.title: Sushiamo - Official Demo Announcement Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sushiamo on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4555040/Sushiamo/

Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

Credits: Music by "Fresh_Morning" on Pixabay
